menu.label: App menu
table.emptyDescription: Whatever you add shows up here.
table.noMatchDescription: Try fewer words or another filter.
math.home.welcome: Welcome! Add a player to start.
math.home.welcomeBody: Each player picks an animal and a starting level. Eight levels, for ages 6 to 14, open one by one along one path.
math.home.noneBody: Players show here once someone adds them.
math.home.full: Six players is the most this app keeps.
math.home.private: Players and their stars are kept only in this app.
math.role.notKept: You can play every open round here. Your stars and your Sound choice are not kept.
math.role.unknown: We could not tell who is using this game, so nothing can be added or kept right now. You can still play every open round.
math.home.notReadable: The saved players could not be read. Nothing was changed.
math.player.name: Name
math.player.namePlaceholder: A first name or a nickname
math.player.levelHint: Levels below it are open to practice. The next ones open one by one, each after the big challenge of the level before.
math.player.removeBody: Their stars and results go too. This cannot be undone.
math.level.name: Level {level}
math.level.answerByChoice: Answers are picked from the choices shown.
math.level.opensOne: Each level opens when the big challenge of the level before is passed.
math.map.roundNotSaved: The stars from your last round of {topic} could not be saved.
math.map.practice: Open to practice: play the stops in any order.
math.map.finished: You finished the whole adventure! Every round stays open to play.
math.map.gateOpens: Opens when every stop has a star
math.gate.name: Big challenge · Level {level}
math.gate.about: Two questions from each stop. {right} right opens the next level.
math.gate.aboutLast: Two questions from each stop. {right} right finishes the adventure.
math.gate.aboutBadge: Two questions from each stop. {right} right wins this level's badge.
math.badges.title: Badges for {name}
math.badges.lead: A level badge for each big challenge passed. A gold badge for 3 stars on every stop and the big challenge of a level.
math.progress.title: Progress for {name}
math.progress.lead: Every topic and big challenge played so far, at every level.
math.round.stopNote: A round counts once all 10 questions are answered.
math.round.notKept: This round is practice. Its stars are not kept.
math.round.question: Question {number} of 10
math.round.unreadable: That is not a number yet. Try again.
math.paper.label: Squared paper for {sum}
math.paper.note: Write one digit in each box, starting from the right. The small boxes are for what you carry or borrow.
math.paper.noteLong: First row: times the ones. Second row: times the tens, one place to the left. Then add the two rows.
math.paper.writeFirst: Write the answer in the bottom row first.
math.paper.gap: Fill the answer's boxes from the right, with no empty box between the digits.
math.paper.noteShare: Start from the left: write an answer digit, take away what it makes, write what is left and bring the next digit down. Then go on the same way.
math.paper.writeFirstShare: Write the answer first, in the top row above the number.
math.paper.gapShare: Write the answer's digits from the left, with no empty box between them.
math.picture.crossed: Things to count, some crossed out
math.picture.rectangle: A rectangle {a} cm long and {b} cm wide
math.picture.blocksSum: The two numbers drawn as blocks of tens and ones
math.picture.marbles: A bag of marbles. Red: {red}. Blue: {blue}.
math.end.notSaved: These stars could not be saved.
math.end.moment.finishedBody: All eight levels are passed. Every round stays open to play.
math.end.moment.levelOpenedBody: You passed the big challenge and won a badge. Next: {land}.
math.end.line.gold: You won the level {level} gold badge.
math.problem.refused: The game could not take that. Please try again.
math.problem.full: There are already six players. Remove one to add another.
math.problem.noPlayer: That player is not here any more.
math.problem.countFull: This topic cannot count any more rounds for this player.
math.problem.locked: This round is not open yet. Play the stops before it first.
math.q.sign: Which sign goes in the box?
math.q.box: Which number goes in the box?
math.q.tensOnes: {tens} tens and {ones} ones make which number?
math.q.partOfOne: Split {n} into {d} equal parts. How much is one part?
math.q.partOfMany: Split {n} into {d} equal parts. How much do {k} parts make together?
math.q.perimeter: A rectangle is {a} cm long and {b} cm wide. How many cm is it all the way around?
math.q.area: A rectangle is {a} cm long and {b} cm wide. What is its area in cm²?
math.q.areaSquare: A square has sides of {a} cm. What is its area in cm²?
math.q.percentUp: {n} goes up by {p}%. What is the new number?
math.q.percentDown: {n} goes down by {p}%. What is the new number?
math.q.greatestFactor: What is the greatest common factor of {a} and {b}?
math.q.leastMultiple: What is the least common multiple of {a} and {b}?
math.q.toDecimal: Write this fraction as a decimal number.
math.q.ratio: Share {n} in the ratio {a} : {b}. How big is the larger share?
math.q.hypotenuse: A right triangle has short sides of {a} cm and {b} cm. How long is the longest side, in cm?
math.q.leg: A right triangle has one short side of {a} cm and a longest side of {c} cm. How long is the other short side, in cm?
math.q.power: Which power goes in the box?
math.q.evaluate: If x = {x}, what is the value?
math.q.blocksNumber: What number do the blocks show?
math.q.anglesLine: Two angles on a straight line make 180°. How many degrees is the missing angle?
math.q.anglesPoint: The angles around a point make 360°. How many degrees is the missing angle?
math.q.anglesRight: Two angles make a right angle, 90°. How many degrees is the missing angle?
math.q.anglesTriangle: The three angles of a triangle make 180°. How many degrees is the missing angle?
math.q.mean: What is the average of these numbers?
math.q.chanceRed: You take one marble from the bag without looking. What is the chance that it is red? Write it as a fraction.
math.q.chanceDice: You roll a dice. What is the chance of a number bigger than {n}? Write it as a fraction.
math.q.patternTerm: The pattern goes on in the same way. What is term number {n}?
math.helper.title: Your helper
math.helper.leadBefore: Stuck? Ask for a hint, or ask a question.
math.helper.leadAfter: Want to know why? Ask your helper.
math.helper.askFirst: Type or say your question first.
math.helper.asksUsed: You asked all three questions for this one. You can ask again on the next question.
math.helper.isAi: Your helper is AI and can make mistakes.
math.helper.aiVoice: Its voice is an AI voice.
math.helper.macInstead: This device reads aloud instead of the AI voice for now.
math.helper.refused: Your helper could not take that. Try asking in another way.
math.helper.empty: Your helper could not answer this time. Try again.
math.helper.speak.noMicrophone: Math adventure cannot reach a microphone. In Tellop, turn on "Use camera and devices" for this app. In a web browser, allow the microphone for this page.
math.helper.speak.notAllowed: The microphone isn't allowed. In Tellop, turn on "Use camera and devices" for this app. If it is on, allow the microphone for Tellop in this computer's Privacy & Security settings. In a web browser, allow the microphone for this page.
math.helper.speak.cannotRecord: Recording could not start. Try again.
math.helper.speak.nothingHeard: Nothing was heard. Speak a little louder and try again.
math.helper.gaveAway: Your helper nearly gave the answer away, so it kept quiet. Ask in another way, or try it yourself!
math.helper.speak.notTaken: Tellop cannot write a spoken question down yet. Type your question instead.
